title: Freeman Dyson on IDA advisory board
summary: Bob Maguire tells of Freeman Dyson on IDA advisory board, about unspecified at Institute for Defense Analysis, Center for Communications Research, New Jersey, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Institute for Defense Analysis, Center for Communications Research, New Jersey

tellings.quote: where I worked a member of The Advisory board for that place that I worked Freeman Dyson was on it

plain: Bob Maguire, who says he worked as a contractor for the CIA, the US spy agency, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he once worked at the Institute for Defense Analysis's Center for Communications Research in New Jersey, a research group that does work for the US government. He says the famous physicist Freeman Dyson sat on that center's advisory board. He tells it to show the kind of top-level scientific company his workplace kept.
